narrative.intro: Ram System Gmbh obligated $487M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Ram System Gmbh won 8 awards during the period, with an average award size of $60.9M, and obligations are up 10.5% year over year. Ram System Gmbh’s obligations by fiscal year show large swings, including $136M in FY21, $6M in FY22, $680M in FY23, $11.9M in FY24, $441M in FY25, and $487M in FY26. Ram System Gmbh’s current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date obligations. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing accounts for $487M of obligations in FY2026 to date. The figures represent contract obligations except where tables list award-value totals, and the published tables show both positive and negative obligation entries where they appear.

sections.heading: How has Ram System Gmbh’s federal contracting trended year over year?
sections.body: Ram System Gmbh obligated $487M in FY26 to date, up 10.5% year over year. Ram System Gmbh’s obligations have varied by year: $136M in FY21, $6M in FY22, $680M in FY23, $11.9M in FY24, $441M in FY25, and $487M in FY26. Ram System Gmbh’s average award size in the current period is $60.9M across 8 awards. The current-year totals are partial and fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: Where and in what industries does Ram System Gmbh do business with the federal government?
sections.body: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the largest market for Ram System Gmbh, with $487M in FY26 to date. Bare Printed Circuit Board Manufacturing also appears in the market list. Ram System Gmbh’s awards and obligations in FY2026 to date are concentrated in those NAICS categories. The published figures show a focused industrial footprint rather than a broad spread across many markets.
